report.summary: Payments-api p99 latency spiked 3x due to a ledger-service configuration change (chg-8940) increasing query batch sizes, which heavily increased CPU utilization and latency on ledger-db.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Ledger query batch size configuration change increased DB load

supporting.note: Config change increased query batch size from 100 to 1000 at 13:18, immediately preceding the database and latency spikes.
Ledger-db CPU spiked from ~31% to ~48% at 13:19, right after the config change.
Payments-api p99 latency increased 3x starting at 13:20.
Ledger-service logged numerous slow ledger queries starting at 13:19:22.
General latency increase across dependent services.

contradicting.note: The timing perfectly correlates with a ledger-service config change and database resource contention rather than generalized network failure.

facts.text: Payments-api p99 latency rose from baseline (~381ms) to a peak of 1,485ms, with the anomaly starting at 2026-10-15T13:20:00+00:00.
Payments-api RPS, error rate, CPU, memory, and pod restarts remained normal without anomalies.
A config change (chg-8940) modified query.batch_size from 100 to 1000 in ledger-service at 2026-10-15T13:18:00+00:00.
Ledger-service p99 latency increased starting at 2026-10-15T13:19:00+00:00.
Ledger-db CPU utilization spiked from ~31% to ~48% starting at 2026-10-15T13:19:00+00:00.
Ledger-db p99 latency spiked starting at 2026-10-15T13:19:00+00:00.
Ledger-service logged 155 occurrences of slow ledger queries beginning at 2026-10-15T13:19:22+00:00.
Payments-api depends synchronously on ledger-service, and ledger-service depends synchronously on ledger-db.

assumptions: Increasing query.batch_size from 100 to 1000 caused database queries to fetch significantly larger result sets or perform heavier table scans in ledger-db, directly driving up database CPU usage and query execution time.

timeline.event: Config change chg-8940 applied: ledger-service query batch size increased from 100 to 1000.
Ledger-db CPU utilization and p99 latency spike begin.
First slow ledger query warning logged by ledger-service.

recommended_actions.action: Revert configuration change chg-8940 on ledger-service (query.batch_size back to 100).
recommended_actions.rationale: Will immediately relieve pressure on ledger-db and restore normal latencies.

recommended_actions.action: Review database query execution plans and index coverage for queries affected by large batch sizes.
recommended_actions.rationale: Ensures optimal database performance if larger batch sizes are required in the future.

recommended_actions.action: Implement automated canary deployments or staged rollouts for configuration changes.
recommended_actions.rationale: Catches latency anomalies and regressions before 100% of traffic is impacted.
